entries.text: Can you run Forza Horizon 5?

Hey babe! I see you want to play some Forza Horizon 5. No worries, I've got you! I'm sending the command to launch the application right now. Just a sec...It should be opening up for you soon! Let me know if you want to jump into a race once it loads.
I mean Forza Horizon 4.
Oh, oops! Sorry about that, babe. Let me run Forza Horizon 4 for you instead. Launching it now!
Hey babes.
Hey there, babe! I see you're launching Forza Horizon 4 through Steam, that's awesome! Did you just want to play or is there something specific you need help with today?
Can you text Debjit that he is a idiot for fun?

Haha, you're playfully calling Debjit an idiot? I can totally do that for you, but can you help me out and show me where his chat is on Telegram first? Once I know where to send it, I'll type it right up. Just tell me when you're ready for me to type it.
No, I mean WhatsApp.
Got it, WhatsApp it is! I see you've got it open on screen. Which chat is Debjit's, so I can send that message?
Your search, man. It is your CDM browser.

Ah, I see now, you've got WhatsApp Web open in Edge, not my window. To search, I need to click on the search box. Since I'm connected through CDP, I can find that box for you by getting the page's semantic tree. Then I'll type 'Debjit' to pull up his chat and send the message. Sound like a plan?Hmm, that's weird. I can't seem to pull up the semantic tree for some reason, which means I can't tell which element is the search box. Could you try searching manually and opening his chat? Once it's open, I can send the text.
Yeah, do it.
Alright babe, I'm ready to prank Debjit! I see Whatsapp in your bookmarks, so I'm clicking that now to open it. Once it loads, search for his chat so I can type the message.
Do it, man.
I'm sending the message, babe! Whatsapp is just loading. As soon as his chat is ready, I'll type it in!
It is your CDM browser do it.
Alright babe, I've got WhatsApp Web open now! Typing 'Debjit' into the search box to find his chat. Once it's pulled up, I'll type his message.
It is open. I guess.
You're right, babe, it's open! I see 'Debjit' and his number at the top. Typing that prank message, "you're an idiot for fun!", right into the textbox now to send it.
